The effective projected area A, corresponding to the force at storey level z may be
computed by:

A= half of the effective projected area of storey above level z
+ half of the effective projected area of storey below level z

Clause 7.6 of the Code requires the resonant dynamic effects of the following
categories of enclosed buildings to be investigated in accordance with
recommendations given in published literature or through the use of dynamic wind
tunnel model studies: :

(1) Buildings for which the fundamental natural frequency is less than 0.2 Hz.

(2) Buildings with significant cross-wind resonant response or torsional resonant
response.

Example calculation of the total force acting on a multi-storey building not significant
in resonant dynamic response is given in Appendix A. Example calculation of th
total force acting on a multi-storey building significant in resonant dynamic response
is given in Appendix B.
